# Jérôme Schaeffer — Personal Portfolio

> Senior product engineer based in Seoul, South Korea. Portfolio and résumé site.

## About

Jérôme Schaeffer is a senior product engineer based in Seoul, South Korea with 11+ years across frontend, full-stack and AI/AX work. His work includes React/Three.js Beamo digital-twin viewers, Pivo web applications, AI products, MCP integrations and company-wide Claude adoption. His current role at 3i is Frontend Developer & AX Engineer. This site serves as his personal portfolio and online résumé.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.jers.dev/): Portfolio in English
- [Beamo digital-twin viewer](https://www.jers.dev/work/beamo/): React and Three.js case study with an interactive measurement demo
- [Pivo Meet remote coaching](https://www.jers.dev/work/pivo-meet/): Vue and Agora case study with an interactive sample lesson
- [Pivo Cloud video library](https://www.jers.dev/work/pivo-cloud/): Vue gallery case study with an interactive sample library
- [Pivo Coaches directory](https://www.jers.dev/work/pivo-coaches/): React case study with a searchable sample directory of equestrian coaches
- [Pivo CS / QA support triage](https://www.jers.dev/work/pivo-cs-qa/): React intranet case study with an interactive support report queue
- [Work](https://www.jers.dev/#work/3i): Professional experience and side projects
- [About](https://www.jers.dev/#about): Career timeline
